# Native preflight protocol fixture

This is a disposable three-test application, not Localica product coverage. The
branch-only workflow copies the current Gradle wrapper, version catalog, settings,
and unchanged production runner/evidence helpers. It never edits product sources
or adds a permissive inventory selector to the production runner.

On API 26 and 36 it first proves two comma-separated `notClass` exclusions against
three explicitly selected test classes, preserving raw reports and APK hashes.
It then uses the real risk-first shell and its complete source inventory: two
preflight methods plus one remainder, each exactly once. Independent XML checks
require the precise identities and zero skips/failures/errors. The complete union,
live observation, raw XML, resolved dependency report, and APK hashes are archived.
The successful three-case smoke is not a 1,151/1,152-case full-suite pass and does
not establish savings or release certification. Offline contracts cover rejection
and nonzero/no-output fault injection without deliberately making a native red run.
